ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p182/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p182/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p182/r1.claim: Brief reminders about creation, life’s sources, death, and resurrection expose the transience of arrogant pride and point to Judgment.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p182/r1.anchor: In these verses, the pride and vanity of these people is condemned

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p182/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p182/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p182/r2.claim: Quraysh assumed their worldly respect and leadership would continue after Judgment; 70:36–39 challenges their expectation of Paradise.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p182/r2.anchor: the warning sounded by the Prophet (sws)

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p183/r1.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p183/r1.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p183/r1.claim: Across the Qur’an, human creation and its phases are used to establish resurrection; Islahi says this topic appears in various styles.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p183/r1.anchor: This topic is mentioned in the

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p183/r2.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p183/r2.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p183/r2.claim: Being created from an impure drop gives people no grounds to boast of purity, superiority, or entitlement to Paradise.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p183/r2.anchor: boast of their purity and superiority

ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p183/r3.author: Amin Ahsan Islahi (d. 1997)
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p183/r3.speaker: author
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p183/r3.claim: Islahi illustrates the resurrection argument with 23:12–16’s account of human creation from clay through successive stages and restoration after death.
ISLAHI-TADABBUR:vol-9-english:p183/r3.anchor: And We first created man from an essence of clay

ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p409/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p409/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p409/r1.claim: The question من أي شيء خلقه stresses the lowly material of human creation.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p409/r1.anchor: من أي شيء خلقه: استفهام على معنى التقرير على حقارة ما خلق منه.

BIQAI-FULL:v8p322#s080/r1.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p322#s080/r1.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p322#s080/r1.claim: The surah explains the call to warn those who fear by using resurrection to purify receptive hearts; human creation and the cycle of food prove God’s power, making rejection astonishing.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p322#s080/r1.anchor: بأن المراد الأعظم تزكية القابل للخشية بالتخويف بالقيامة

RAZI-FULL:v31p55/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p55/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p55/r1.claim: Rāzī identifies the question about human origin as the first of the three stages he says the passage will detail.
RAZI-FULL:v31p55/r1.anchor: أما المرتبة الأولى : فهي قوله : { من أى شىء خلقه }

RAZI-FULL:v31p55#2/r1.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v31p55#2/r1.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v31p55#2/r1.claim: The question is rhetorical and intended to intensify the belittling of human beings.
RAZI-FULL:v31p55#2/r1.anchor: وهو استفهام وغرضه زيادة التقرير في التحقير

STUDYQURAN:80:18/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:80:18/r1.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:80:18/r1.claim: Creation of the human from a drop is evidence of God's Omnipotence, as in other passages.
STUDYQURAN:80:18/r1.anchor: This is one of several passages in which the creation of the human being from a drop is cited as evidence of God’s Omnipotence

TAB-FULL:v24p111/r1.author: al-Ṭabarī
TAB-FULL:v24p111/r1.speaker: author
TAB-FULL:v24p111/r1.claim: The question challenges the disbeliever's arrogance: from what did his Lord create him that he should disdain obedience and acknowledgment of God's oneness?
TAB-FULL:v24p111/r1.anchor: يقول تعالى ذكره: من أي شيء خلق الإنسان الكافر ربه حتى يتكبر. ويتعظم عن طاعة ربه، والإقرار بتوحيده

TABATABAI:80:17-19/r1.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:80:17-19/r1.speaker: author
TABATABAI:80:17-19/r1.claim: The passage condemns human ingratitude and recalls that God creates, measures, guides, causes death, buries, and resurrects the human, who owns none of this governance.
TABATABAI:80:17-19/r1.anchor: بيان دعاء على الانسان وتعجيب من مبالغته في الكفر بربوبية ربه وإشارة إلى أمره حدوثا وبقاء فإنه لا يملك لنفسه شيئا

TABATABAI:80:17-19/r2.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:80:17-19/r2.speaker: author
TABATABAI:80:17-19/r2.claim: Even food alone displays God's vast, subtle governance and immeasurable mercy; overlooking this care and failing to give thanks is astonishing human injustice and ingratitude.
TABATABAI:80:17-19/r2.anchor: ولو نظر الإنسان إلى طعامه فقط وهو مظهر واحد من مظاهر تدبيره وغرفة من بحار رحمته رأى من وسيع التدبير ولطيف الصنع

TABATABAI:80:17-19/r3.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:80:17-19/r3.speaker: author
TABATABAI:80:17-19/r3.claim: These verses can continue the preceding passage as one context, although some commentators say they were revealed for a separate occasion discussed later.
TABATABAI:80:17-19/r3.anchor: لا تأبى الاتصال بما قبلها سياقا واحدا وإن قال بعضهم أنها نزلت لسبب آخر كما سيجيء

TABATABAI:80:17-19/r9.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:80:17-19/r9.speaker: author
TABATABAI:80:17-19/r9.claim: The question asks what God created the human from that could entitle him to transgress and resist faith; it sets up the answer that he has no such ground or excuse.
TABATABAI:80:17-19/r9.anchor: معناه على ما يعطيه المقام من أي شيء خلق الله الإنسان حتى يحق له أن يطغى ويستكبر عن الإيمان والطاعة

TABATABAI:80:17-19/r10.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:80:17-19/r10.speaker: author
TABATABAI:80:17-19/r10.claim: The agent of created and the following verbs is omitted because it is self-evident: innate knowledge, acknowledged even by polytheists, makes clear that God alone creates.

TABATABAI:80:17-19/r11.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:80:17-19/r11.speaker: author
TABATABAI:80:17-19/r11.claim: The second question intensifies the astonishment in the first: since wonder concerns events without an apparent cause, it asks whether creation gave any cause for disbelief, then prepares the answer in verse 19.
TABATABAI:80:17-19/r11.anchor: والعجب إنما هو في الحوادث التي لا يظهر لها سبب

BURSEVI:v10p260/r7.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p260/r7.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p260/r7.claim: The question reminds the human being of his humble origin, exposing how unfitting pride, arrogance, and ingratitude are toward his benefactor.
BURSEVI:v10p260/r7.anchor: من أي شيء حقير مهين خلقه يعني نمى انديشدكه خداي تعالى

WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p222/r1.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p222/r1.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p222/r1.claim: Although phrased as a question, it is a reminder affirming that God created the human and that He is one.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v23p222/r1.anchor: {من أي شيء خلقه} لفظه استفهام، ومعناه التقرير

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:80:6-18/r13.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:80:6-18/r13.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:80:6-18/r13.claim: The question is rhetorical confirmation, after which God explains the stages of creation.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:80:6-18/r13.anchor: { من أي شيء خلقه } استفهام معناه التقرير، ثم فسر فقال:

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:80:17/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:80:17/r3.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:80:17/r3.claim: By recalling how humans came into existence after nonexistence, the verses urge the deniers and anyone doubtful about resurrection to reflect and believe.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:80:17/r3.anchor: insanın hiç yokken varlık alanına nasıl çıkarıldığı hatırlatılmakta, böylece insanlar düşünme ve inanmaya teşvik edilmektedir

QUSHAYRI:v3p392/r24.author: al-Qushayrī
QUSHAYRI:v3p392/r24.speaker: author
QUSHAYRI:v3p392/r24.claim: God created, formed, and proportioned the human being through successive stages: a drop, then a clot, then stage after stage.
QUSHAYRI:v3p392/r24.anchor: خلقه وصوره وقدره أطوارا : من نطفة ، ثم علقة ، ثم طورا بعد طور

BURHAN:v4p92/r4.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p92/r4.speaker: الزمخشري
BURHAN:v4p92/r4.claim: Al-Zamakhshari says the question belittles the human origin as something low and contemptible, then identifies it as a drop of semen.
BURHAN:v4p92/r4.anchor: قال الزمخشري أي ( 7 ) من شئ حقير مهين ثم بينه

BURHAN:v4p93/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v4p93/r1.speaker: author
BURHAN:v4p93/r1.claim: Context determines whether a question conveys exaltation or belittlement: the next verse’s ‘from a drop He created him’ makes ‘from what thing?’ belittling.

ITQAN:v2p556/r6.author: al-Suyūṭī
ITQAN:v2p556/r6.speaker: author
ITQAN:v2p556/r6.claim: An indefinite may belittle: the question 'from what thing?' points to man's lowly origin, then specifies a drop of fluid.
ITQAN:v2p556/r6.anchor: ﴿ من أي شيء خلقه ﴾ أي من شيء حقير مهين ثم بينه بقوله ﴿ من نطفة خلقه ﴾

FARRA:v3p237/r1.author: al-Farrāʾ
FARRA:v3p237/r1.speaker: author
FARRA:v3p237/r1.claim: The question is answered by his origin as a sperm, then a clot and subsequent stages; God decreed his outcome as wretched or blessed and male or female.

IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p190/r1.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p190/r1.speaker: علي
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p190/r1.claim: An early authority, whom Ibn Qutayba thinks may be ʿAli, says al-raḥim derives from al-Raḥmān.
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p190/r1.anchor: وروي أن بعض السلف وأحسبه عليا رحمة الله عليه، قال: الرحم هو من الرحمن

IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p190/r2.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p190/r2.speaker: قوم من المفسرين
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p190/r2.claim: Some commentators gloss Ṭā Hā as 'man,' Yā Sīn as 'human,' and Nūn as an inkwell.
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p190/r2.anchor: وقد كان (قوم من المفسرين) يفسرون بعض هذه الحروف فيقولون: (طه) يا رجل، و (يس) يا إنسان، و (نون) الدواة

IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p190/r3.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p190/r3.speaker: آخر
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p190/r3.claim: Another interpreter takes Nūn as a whale, Ḥā Mīm as a decree that what will be has been settled, and Qāf as a mountain encircling earth.
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p190/r3.anchor: وقال (آخر) : (الحوت) و (حم) : قضي والله ما هو كائن، و (قاف) : جبل محيط بالأرض

IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p190/r4.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p190/r4.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p190/r4.claim: Ṣād with a kasra on its dāl is connected to muṣādāh, meaning opposition or matching.
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p190/r4.anchor: و (صاد) - بكسر الدال- من المصاداة وهي المعارضة

IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p190/r5.author: Ibn Qutayba
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p190/r5.speaker: author
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p190/r5.claim: Ibn Qutayba declines these letter interpretations because he does not know their source or explanation, apart from the Ṣād view.
IBNQUTAYBA-MUSHKIL:v1p190/r5.anchor: وهذا ما لا نعرض فيه، لأنا لا ندري كيف هو ولا من أي شيء أخذ خلا (صاد)

NAHHAS:v5p151/r4.author: Abū Jaʿfar al-Naḥḥās
NAHHAS:v5p151/r4.speaker: author
NAHHAS:v5p151/r4.claim: Humans are created from something lowly and become noble through obedience to God.
NAHHAS:v5p151/r4.anchor: أي وإنما خلق من قذر وإنما ينبل بطاعة الله

ZAJJAJ:v5p284/r4.author: al-Zajjāj
ZAJJAJ:v5p284/r4.speaker: author
ZAJJAJ:v5p284/r4.claim: The phrase is formally interrogative but functions as an assertion or reminder, then specifies what he was created from.
ZAJJAJ:v5p284/r4.anchor: على لفظ الاستفهام، ومعناه التقرير ثم بين فقال

ASAD-NOTES:80:17#n6/r2.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:80:17#n6/r2.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:80:17#n6/r2.claim: Although verses 18–22 use the past tense, Asad says they describe a recurring phenomenon.
ASAD-NOTES:80:17#n6/r2.anchor: Verses 18-22, although formulated in the past tense, obviously describe a recurrent phenomenon.

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p786/r1.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p786/r1.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p786/r1.claim: With nominative لا خوفٌ عليهم, the phrase may either attach to خوف with an omitted predicate or function itself as the predicate, allowing two readings of the syntax.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p786/r1.anchor: في الرفع (لا خوفٌ عليهم) تدل على معنيين

SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p786/r2.author: فاضل صالح السامرائي
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p786/r2.speaker: author
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p786/r2.claim: With accusative لا خوفَ عليهم, عليهم must be the predicate, yielding only one analysis; if attached to the construct it would instead be accusative with tanwin, not built on fatha.
SAMARRAI-LAMASAT-HALAQAT:p786/r2.anchor: أما في النصب (لا خوفَ عليهم) لا يمكن أن يكون هذا الأمر ولابد أن يكون الجار والمجرور هو الخبر

ALUSI-FULL:v30p44/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p44/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v30p44/r1.claim: The question begins detailing how human ingratitude contrasts with the many favors God gave from the beginning of creation through life; it asks for the source of his creation.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p44/r1.anchor: شروع فيبيان إفراطه في الكفران بتفصيل ما أفاض عز وجل عليه من مبدأ فطرته إلى منتهى عمره من فنون النعم

ALUSI-FULL:v30p44/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v30p44/r2.speaker: قيل
ALUSI-FULL:v30p44/r2.claim: The question is said to belittle the human being.
ALUSI-FULL:v30p44/r2.anchor: والستفهام قيل للتحقير وذكر الجواب أعني قوله تعالى

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p337/r10.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p337/r10.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p337/r10.claim: The question is phrased as an interrogative but functions as an assertion establishing the answer.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p337/r10.anchor: من أي شيء خلقه} لظفه استفهام ومعناه التقرير.

BAYDAWI-FULL:80:17-20/r4.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:80:17-20/r4.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:80:17-20/r4.claim: The question recalls God's particular favor in bringing the person into existence.
BAYDAWI-FULL:80:17-20/r4.anchor: بيان لما أنعم عليه خصوصا من مبدأ حدوثه

BAYDAWI-FULL:80:17-20/r5.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:80:17-20/r5.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:80:17-20/r5.claim: The question belittles the human origin, which the following verse answers.
BAYDAWI-FULL:80:17-20/r5.anchor: والاستفهام للتحقير ولذلك أجاب عنه بقوله

BIQAI-FULL:v8p328/r3.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p328/r3.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p328/r3.claim: Because denial of the Resurrection is the main issue, the argument turns to the human being’s origin, contrasting lowly beginnings with the honor God later gives.

BIQAI-FULL:v8p328/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p328/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p328/r4.claim: The question is a rhetorical prompt to acknowledge the answer while belittling the human origin.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p121/r10.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p121/r10.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p121/r10.claim: The question explains the denunciation by arguing against their rejection of resurrection, a central basis of their unbelief.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p121/r10.anchor: وجملة { من أي شيء خلقه } بيان لجملة { قتل الإنسان ما أكفره } ، لأن مفاد هذه الجملة الاستدلال على إبطال إحالتهم البعث

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p122/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p122/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p122/r1.claim: The question-and-answer arrangement builds anticipation, like the earlier question about the great news.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p122/r1.anchor: وجيء في هذا الاستدلال بصورة سؤال وجواب للتشويق إلى مضمونه ، ولذلك قرن الاستفهام بالجواب عنه

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p122/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p122/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p122/r2.claim: The question is formal: it asks what substance formed the human, not whether God created him; its point is to establish the possibility of recreating him by analogy with the first creation.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p122/r2.anchor: والاستفهام صوري ، وجعل المستفهم عنه تعيين الأمر الذي به خلق الإنسان لأن المقام هنا ليس لإثبات أن الله خلق الإنسان

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p122/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p122/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p122/r3.claim: The unspoken subject of ‘created him’ is God, understood from the act of creation; the polytheists did not deny that God created humanity.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p122/r3.anchor: لأن المشركين لم يكونوا ينكرون أن الله خالق الإنسان .

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#19/r10.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#19/r10.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#19/r10.claim: The question explains the preceding denunciation by arguing against denial of resurrection, one of the greatest bases of their disbelief.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#19/r10.anchor: وجملة { من أي شيء خلقه } بيان لجملة { قتل الإنسان ما أكفره } ، لأن مفاد هذه الجملة الاستدلال على إبطال إحالتهم البعث

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#19/r11.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#19/r11.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#19/r11.claim: The question-and-answer form draws readers toward the proof, as in the opening question about the great news.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#19/r11.anchor: وجيء في هذا الاستدلال بصورة سؤال وجواب للتشويق إلى مضمونه ، ولذلك قرن الاستفهام بالجواب عنه على الطريقة المتقدمة

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#20/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#20/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#20/r1.claim: The question is formal: it asks what substance the human was created from, not whether God created him, and establishes that recreation is possible by analogy with first creation.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#20/r1.anchor: والاستفهام صوري ، وجعل المستفهم عنه تعيين الأمر الذي به خلق الإنسان لأن المقام هنا ليس لإثبات أن الله خلق الإنسان

IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#20/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#20/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#20/r2.claim: The unexpressed subject of “created him” is God, understood from the act of creation; the polytheists did not deny that God created humanity.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v30p138#20/r2.anchor: والضمير المستتر في قوله : خلقه } عائد إلى لله تعالى المعلوم من فعل الخلق لأن المشركين لم يكونوا ينكرون أن الله خالق الإنسان .

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p438#2/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p438#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p438#2/r1.claim: The question makes the human consider his paltry origin; context determines whether it belittles or magnifies.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p438#2/r1.anchor: من أي شيء خلقه استفهام على معنى التقرير على تفاهة الشيء الذي خلق الإنسان منه،

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p438#2/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p438#2/r2.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p438#2/r2.claim: Ibn Atiyya compares this with the question about Judgment Day in 77:13.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p438#2/r2.anchor: وهذا نظير قوله: لأي يوم أجلت ليوم الفصل

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p438#2/r3.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p438#2/r3.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p438#2/r3.claim: The indicated substance is the man’s fluid and the woman’s fluid.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p438#2/r3.anchor: واللفظ المشار إليه ماء الرجل وماء المرأة،

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p31/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p31/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p31/r1.claim: The next verse answers and explains the question about what the human was created from.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v9p31/r1.anchor: قوله تعالى ﴿ من أي شيء خلقه ﴾ ثم فسره فقال تعالى

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p322#3/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p322#3/r6.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p322#3/r6.claim: God reminds the person of creation from a lowly drop and of the destiny He apportioned—lifespan, provision, deeds, and whether one is wretched or blessed—as proof He can recreate him.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p322#3/r6.anchor: أي: قدر أجله ورزقه وعمله وشقي أو سعيد.

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p703#2/r4.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p703#2/r4.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p703#2/r4.claim: The question means: from what lowly, contemptible thing did God create him? Its answer follows in the next verse.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p703#2/r4.anchor: من أي شيء حقير مهين خلقه

MUQATIL:80:18-23/r1.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:80:18-23/r1.speaker: author
MUQATIL:80:18-23/r1.claim: God explains the human’s creation so that he will reflect on it.
MUQATIL:80:18-23/r1.anchor: فأعلمه كيف خلقه ليعتبر في خلقه

NASAFI-FULL:v4p317#16/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p317#16/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p317#16/r1.claim: The question means “from what lowly thing was he created?” and serves to affirm his humble origin before the next verse answers.
NASAFI-FULL:v4p317#16/r1.anchor: من أى حقير خلقه وهو استفهام ومعناه التقرير

QURTUBI-FULL:80:17-19/r9.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:80:17-19/r9.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:80:17-19/r9.claim: The question asks what God created this unbeliever from that he should act arrogantly, and calls people to marvel at his creation.
QURTUBI-FULL:80:17-19/r9.anchor: أي من أي شيء خلق الله هذا الكافر فيتكبر؟ أي اعجبوا لخلقه
